observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 40 stand in the left margin and the locator «p. 132.» (L25) in the right margin. The first figures of 20, 25 and 30 and the 5 of 25 and of 35 are printed broken.
body L6: a thin spike rises from the top of the a of «gradus», joined to the letter; it is not an accent.
body L7: the e of «De» is printed broken.
body L12: «positione» is printed so, where «secundum earum» asks for «positionem»; kept as printed.

body L15, L16, L17, L21, L22, L28, L30: the o is printed thin, its two sides as broken strokes, in «propor-», «apparitionis» (L16 and L30), «correctionis», «maior», «proportionalem» (the second o) and «deminutione».
body L27: the e of «numerus» is printed broken, like a c.
body L30: a speck stands under the line before «aequata»; it is not a sign.
body L36: the a of «ante» is printed broken, like a turned e.
body L40: the hyphen of «si-» is printed short, as a point at mid height.
body L41: the letter of the reference (c) is bold italic.
notes_left L2: the u of «qui» is printed broken, in two strokes.
notes_left L4: the note ends with a comma, «putantur,», where a full stop is expected; kept as printed.

notes_right L3, L4: ما (41) and ٮا or يا (11) are the numbers in Arabic letters; ٮا is printed without dots, يا with the two dots of the yā' below. The e of «vel» is printed broken: a point and a short stroke of it remain.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
